DECLARE @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE [datetime]

		SELECT 		
			@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE=MAX(DD.FULLDATE)		
		FROM 
			EDS.EDS_CTL EC
		INNER JOIN
			EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			ON
			EC.DEPOSITS_DATE=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			AND 
            DD.business_day_flag = 'Y'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			ON
			DD.FULLDATE=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON
			OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
			AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='DEP'
			AND OT.TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEPOSIT_FACT'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON
			OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
		WHERE
			OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'

		UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_CTL] SET DEPOSITS_DATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE, DID_DATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE WHERE  @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE IS NOT NULL;
